disc.title: Information
disc.body: Pet Aura reveals your pet's world: its aura, horoscope and the energies of its space. It does not replace a veterinary examination – if you are worried about your pet, see a vet.
home.empty: Photograph your pet to reveal their aura
tip.red: The red in the background is rattling the root chakra. Swap it for something earthy, like a brown or green blanket.
tip.yellow: Lots of yellow, lots of sparkle. Keep a calm corner nearby so the energy can settle.
tip.green: Green is lifting the heart chakra. Keep a plant, or a green cushion, near the favourite nap spot.
tip.blue: Blue brings calm. A soft blue blanket in the north corner keeps it flowing.
tip.purple: Purple stirs the third eye. A tidy, quiet window spot suits this mood.
tip.neutral: A balanced backdrop. Try a green cushion in the north corner for a little extra grounding.
el.fire: Fire energy: bold and restless today. Plan a playful run to burn it off.
el.earth: Earth energy: steady and food-minded. A calm walk suits the day.
el.air: Air energy: curious and chatty. New smells and a puzzle toy will delight.
el.water: Water energy: soft and cuddly. Plenty of quiet time together.
